home.aboutTitle: Code with judgement, products with intent
home.aboutText: It's not just about working. It's about being fast, accessible, maintainable and trustworthy from the first click. I treat the frontend with the same care I would give an API.
home.projectsText: Web products, downloadable apps and AI experiments. Every case study includes the stack, challenges and development time.
home.blogText: Long articles and snippets about what I learn while building. No fluff, just code you can take to your own project.
home.resourcesText: PDFs about Spec Driven Development, Markdown, AI-assisted development and agents. Download, read and share.
home.newsletterTitle: Once a month, something worth your time
home.newsletterText: Ideas, resources and lessons about web development and AI. Double opt-in, one-click unsubscribe and zero spam.
home.contactText: Tell me what you have in mind. I reply within 24–48 working hours.

about.title: Web developer and UI/UX designer with a soft spot for detail
about.lead: I'm Alex. I design and build web experiences that feel fast, clear and thoughtfully made.
about.p1: I got into the web because I wanted to understand how things worked inside. Today I work at the boundary between design and engineering: polished interfaces, measurable performance and technical decisions that make maintenance easier.
about.p2: I use Next.js, TypeScript and PostgreSQL as my base. I care about accessibility, security and well-applied AI automation: as a copilot, not as a shortcut to skip judgement.
about.p3: This site is my work notebook: a place to publish what I learn, share resources and, above all, learn with other developers.

clarity.title: Clarity first
clarity.text: If it isn't clear, it isn't finished. Readable code, explicit interfaces and useful documentation.

craft.title: Crafted detail
craft.text: Micro-interactions, typography, loading states and error messages. Details build trust.

security.title: Secure by default
security.text: Validation, least privilege and privacy from the first line, not as a final patch.

ai.title: AI with judgement
ai.text: AI speeds things up, but decisions are reviewed. I automate the repetitive and protect what matters.

t1.title: Building alexbyte.dev
t1.text: Portfolio, blog and resources. A place of my own to share and document the process.

t2.title: Projects with applied AI
t2.text: SaaS and automations where AI solves a concrete problem, not decoration.

t3.title: From design to engineering
t3.text: Interfaces, design systems and full-stack development focused on the final experience.

about.ctaText: I have room for freelance projects, collaborations and technical consulting.

privacy.intro: This policy explains what data alexbyte.dev collects, why, and how you can exercise your rights.
privacy.dataText: Data you voluntarily submit in the contact form (name, email, subject and message) and the newsletter (email and consent). We also keep minimal technical logs for site security and operation.
privacy.purposeText: To reply to your messages, send the newsletter if you confirm it, and keep the site secure. We do not use your data for third-party advertising.
privacy.rightsText: You can request access, rectification, erasure, restriction or objection by writing to hola@alexbyte.dev. You can also unsubscribe from any newsletter email.
privacy.contactText: Alex is the data controller. For any privacy question, write to hola@alexbyte.dev.

terms.intro: These terms govern the use of alexbyte.dev and the resources offered on it.
terms.useText: You may browse and download the free resources for personal or professional use. Reselling them, redistributing them as your own or using them for illegal activities is not allowed.
terms.contentText: Texts, brands, code and designs belong to Alex or are used with permission. Projects marked as samples are demonstrations and do not represent real products.
terms.downloadsText: Apps and resources are provided as is, without warranty of availability or fitness for a particular purpose. Before downloading an app you must accept its terms of use and privacy policy.
terms.liabilityText: The site may contain external links whose content we do not control. We are not liable for damages arising from misuse of the site or its resources.
terms.changesText: These terms may be updated. The last updated date indicates the current version.

cookies.intro: alexbyte.dev uses the minimum cookies required to work. Analytics is only enabled with your consent.
cookies.necessaryText: They remember your language and keep the site secure. Without them, some features do not work correctly.
cookies.analyticsText: Google Analytics 4 will only load if you accept analytics, using Consent Mode v2. You can decline it without losing access to the content.
cookies.manageText: You can delete or block cookies in your browser settings. If you decline analytics, no measurement cookies will be installed.
cookies.contactText: If you have questions about cookies, write to hola@alexbyte.dev or read the privacy policy.
